verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a client-side UI framework. It does not host or run user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The semver release policy in the evidence covers the framework's own releases, not user automations, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
